title: EOPSA: Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2609.34519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for safety alignment, delivering dense, token-level supervision by distilling from a teacher conditioned on refusal-oriented privileged prompts. However, we reveal that this paradigm suffers from critical inefficiencies that degrade both training efficiency and general reasoning capabilities. Specifically, we diagnose two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) supervisory collapse over extended rollouts, where the teacher's corrective efficacy degrades precipitously as the student's generation prefix lengthens, injecting noisy gradients into late-stage tokens; and (2) gradient dilution from stylistic shifts, where the distillation objective is dominated by safety-irrelevant stylistic discrepancies induced by privileged prompting, washing out genuine safety signals and impairing base reasoning. translated_title: EOPSA：高效在策略自蒸馏安全对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.34519v2 公告类型：替换。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）已成为一种颇具前景的安全对齐范式，它通过从以拒绝导向特权提示为条件的教师模型中蒸馏，提供密集的词元级监督。然而，我们揭示出该范式存在严重的低效问题，会同时降低训练效率和通用推理能力。具体而言，我们诊断出两个根本性瓶颈：（1）长序列生成中的监督坍缩——随着学生模型生成前缀的延长，教师模型的纠错效能急剧衰退，向后期词元注入噪声梯度；（2）由风格偏移导致的梯度稀释——蒸馏目标被特权提示所引发的与安全无关的风格差异所主导，冲淡了真正的安全信号并损害了基础推理能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出高效在策略自蒸馏安全对齐（EOPSA）……
tldr: 该论文提出EOPSA，通过解决在策略自蒸馏安全对齐中长序列生成导致的监督坍缩和风格偏移引发的梯度稀释两大瓶颈，实现更高效且不损害推理能力的安全对齐。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes EOPSA, which resolves two fundamental bottlenecks in on-policy self-distilled safety alignment—supervisory collapse over extended rollouts and gradient dilution from stylistic shifts—to achieve more efficient safety alignment without impairing base reasoning capabilities.
